chunks: The believer is awake, awaiting, and fearful; he awaits one of the two good outcomes, and fears calamity out of caution for his sins, hoping for the mercy of his Lord, Exalted and Mighty.
The believer is not stripped of his fear and hope; he fears what he has sent forth, does not neglect seeking what God has promised him, and is not safe from what God has warned him of.
You are the cultivators of the Earth, whom God has placed therein to see how you work; so observe Him regarding what He sees from you.
Adhere to the Great Path and walk it, lest others take your place.
Whoever's intellect is perfected, his deeds are good and his gaze upon his religion is sound.
Be swift to forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is the heavens and the earth, prepared for the righteous.
For you will not attain it except through piety.
Whoever becomes rusty with sin, he becomes heedless of the remembrance of God, Exalted and Mighty.
Whoever leaves taking from God's command through obedience, God appoints a devil for him who is his companion.

Why are those who opposed you more steadfast in their error and more generous with what is in their hands than you? It is only because you have relied on the world, accepted injustice, been stingy with trivial gains, and neglected that which brings your honor, happiness, and power over those who oppress you.

You do not feel shy before your Lord regarding what He commanded you, nor do you look after your own selves, while you are oppressed every day, not awakening from your sleep, and your lethargy does not end.
Do you not see that your lands and religion are deteriorating every day, while you are in the heedlessness of the world?
And do not incline to those who do wrong, lest the Fire touch you; and you have no protectors other than God, then you will not be helped.

Name your children. If you do not know if they are male or female, name them with names suitable for both. If your abortuses meet you on the Day of Resurrection and you did not name them, the abortus will say to its father: 'Did you not name me?' And the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) named Mohsen before he was born.
Beware of drinking water while standing on your feet, for it causes a disease for which there is no cure, unless God heals it.
When you ride beasts of burden, remember God and say: 'Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have subdued it. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.'
When one of you goes on a journey, let him say: 'O God, You are the companion in the journey, the one who carries on the back, and the substitute for the family, property, and children.'
And when you settle in a dwelling, say: 'O God, make our dwelling blessed, and You are the best of those who provide dwelling.'

When you buy what you need from the market, say when you enter the markets: 'I bear witness that there is no god but God alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, peace be upon him and his family. O God, I seek refuge in You from a losing deal, a false oath, and the decay of faith.'
He who awaits the time of the next prayer after the current one is among the visitors of God, Exalted and Mighty. It is incumbent upon God to honor His visitor and give him what he asked for.
The pilgrim and the Umrah pilgrim are God's guests, and He loves them with forgiveness.
Whoever gives a child an intoxicant while he does not understand it, God will imprison him in the ooze of Khabal until he comes out from what he did.

Charity is a great shield from the Fire for the believer, and protection for the non-believer from the loss of his wealth. Its replacement is hastened for him and calamities are averted from him, but he has no share in the Hereafter.

With the tongue, the people of Fire fell into the Fire, and with the tongue, the people of Light were given Light. So guard your tongues and occupy them with the remembrance of God, Exalted and Mighty.
The worst of deeds is that which leads to error, and the best of what is earned is the deeds of the righteous.
Beware of making sculptures, for you will be questioned about them on the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ: The two good outcomes (worldly relief or felicitous death)
key_terms.طِينَةِ الْخَبَالِ: Ooze of Khabal (a place in Hell)

ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical and practical teachings for a believer according to Imam Ali in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this comprehensive discourse from *Al-Khisal*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) synthesizes the believer's internal state of *khawf* (fear) and *raja'* (hope) with external practices, framing daily actions like naming children and traveling as acts of worship. The text highlights the concept of *istikhlaaf* (divine vicegerency), urging believers to view themselves as God's agents on earth, thereby linking personal piety to cosmic responsibility. This collection serves as a practical manual for integrating dhikr into mundane activities, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of the spiritual and the worldly.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 27-14 A believer should always be awake, awaiting and frightened. He should be awaiting worldly relief or a felicitous death. He should be frightened by calamities that are punishment for his sins. He should be hopeful of the Honorable the Exalted God’s Mercy.

A believer is not without fright and hope. He is frightened due to his past, but he doesn’t neglect to seek what God has promised. He is not safe from what the Honorable the Exalted God has frightened us from.
You are the cultivators of Earth. The Honorable and the Exalted God has placed you there to see what you do there. Then keep an eye on what God sees you do there.
I advise you to stay on this wide road. Lest others will take over your place.
Whoever has perfected intellect would do good deeds and guard his religion.
‘Be ye foremost (in seeking) Forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden (of Bliss), the width whereof is as the width of heaven and Earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah…’
You would never reach that ‘Garden of Bliss’ unless you are pious.
Those who become filthy with sinful deeds would abandon the Honorable the Exalted God’s remembrance.
God would appoint a satan to be constantly with whomever doesn’t obey those whom the Honorable the Exalted God has ordered us to obey.

Your opponents are more steadfast in their wickedness. They are better in spending money on their desires. Indeed you pay attention to this world on which you rely. You have become used to tolerating cruelty. You are stingy regarding this world’s goods and have neglected what would be better for your honor, comfort and power to overcome those who oppress you.

You are neither ashamed of God regarding what He has ordered you to do, nor would you think about what would be best for you.You are not awakened, although you are oppressed every day. Your feebleness doesn’t end.
Don’t you see that each day your towns and religion suffer more and more, while you are ignorant and entertained with this world.
The Honorable the Exalted God tells you, ‘And incline not to those who do wrong, or the Fire will seize you; and ye have no protectors other than God, nor shall ye be helped.’

You should name your children. In case you do not know their gender (before birth), you can give them a name that is suitable for either boys or girls. Even if it gets aborted, it would question the father on the Resurrection Day for not having named it. God’s Prophet (MGB) had named Fatimah’s (MGB) child Mohsen before he was born.
You should not drink water while standing up, since that would cause a pain for which there is no cure unless the Honorable the Exalted God restores health.

Whenever you mount a quadruped remember the Honorable the Exalted God says, ‘…In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favor of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves). And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back!”’
Whenever you go on a trip you should say: “O Allah, You are the companion in journeys, the helper in transport, and the guard of the wife, property, and sons. ”
When you settle down in a house you should say, “O Allah, grant me a blessed landing. You are the One who provides the safest landing.”

When you go shopping you should say, “I declare there is no god but Allah uniquely without any associate, and declare that Mohammed is His servant and messenger. O Allah, I seek Your safety from losing deals and perjury, and seek Your safety from stagnancy.”

Anyone who awaits for the time of the next prayer is considered to be amongst the visitors of the Honorable the Exalted God. He has a right incumbent upon the Sublime God to honor His visitors and grant them whatever they ask for.
Whoever goes on the Hajj pilgrimage or the Umra Hajj is God’s guest. It is hoped that God would forgive him.
The Sublime God will imprison in oozy grounds in Hell whoever gives a child an alcoholic drink, until he apologizes for what he has done.

Giving charity is a strong shield from the Fire for a believer, and for a nonbeliever is a device to save his money. It is a protection of property for an atheist. Soon it will be returned to him. It would fend off calamities. However, there will be no heavenly reward for it for an atheist.

The residents of Hell shall fall down into the Fire with their tongues first.The residents of Light will be bestowed light through their tongues. Therefore watch your tongues and keep them busy remembering the Honorable the Exalted God.
The most wicked deed is what would lead one to going astray. The best deeds are acts of charity.
Beware not to make any sculptures, since you would be questioned about them on the Resurrection Day.
